body:
Web parity for [[T-138]], which added store suggestions to the Android item
dialog only. The web item dialog already suggests names (registry) and
categories (T-108) but offers nothing for stores, so the two clients now
disagree about what the same dialog does.

Same rule as Android: the distinct stores already used anywhere in this list,
canonical casing, offered as clickable chips under the store input; filtered by
what has been typed; already-added stores excluded. Reuse
distinctCanonicalCategories(raw, []) — the canonicalization rule wanted here is
exactly the one categories use, as on Android (CategoryCanon).
title: web: suggest the list's existing stores while typing one
